Six killed in rain-induced house collapse in Uttar Pradesh

A house collapse in Pratapgarh, Uttar Pradesh, killed six members of the same family, including two infants. The incident occurred due to heavy rainfall. The house was reportedly 100 years old and in a dilapidated condition. Another report mentioned nine deaths across Uttar Pradesh due to rain-related house and wall collapses.
